description: Unit tests for the webfonts_histogram module, testing the behavior of MaybeRecordCacheStatus function with various URL patterns and cache statuses.

methods.name: WebfontsHistogramTest.EmptyKey_NoRecord
methods.description: Tests that no histogram is recorded when an empty key is used.

methods.name: WebfontsHistogramTest.RecordRoboto
methods.description: Tests recording of 'roboto' font cache status.

methods.name: WebfontsHistogramTest.RecordOpenSans
methods.description: Tests recording of 'opensans' font cache status.

methods.name: WebfontsHistogramTest.EmptyFont_RecordOthers
methods.description: Tests that 'others' histogram is recorded for a non-specific cache status.

methods.name: WebfontsHistogramTest.ArbitraryFont_RecordOthers
methods.description: Tests recording of 'others' for arbitrary font patterns.

methods.name: WebfontsHistogramTest.WithSuffix_Record
methods.description: Tests recording when URL has a font suffix.

methods.name: WebfontsHistogramTest.WithPrefix_NoRecord
methods.description: Ensures no recording occurs when URL has an unexpected prefix.

methods.name: WebfontsHistogramTest.OtherProtocol_NoRecord
methods.description: Ensures no recording for URLs with non-HTTP protocols.

methods.name: WebfontsHistogramTest.OtherPattern_NoRecord
methods.description: Ensures no recording for URLs with non-matching patterns.

methods.name: WebfontsHistogramTest.TwoRobotoSameBucket_TwoOpenSansDifferentBucket
methods.description: Tests multiple cache status recordings for different fonts and URLs, verifying histogram counts.
